title: Certified ScrumMaster (CSM)
overview: The Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) course provides in-depth training on Scrum principles, roles, and practices. It is designed to equip participants with the knowledge and skills needed to effectively facilitate Scrum teams and processes. The course covers the Scrum framework, including roles, events, artifacts, and techniques for supporting and guiding Agile teams.
audience: Individuals new to Scrum or Agile methodologies.
Project managers, team leaders, and Scrum Masters looking to enhance their Scrum knowledge.
Product Owners and stakeholders involved in Scrum projects.
Professionals seeking certification to advance their careers in Agile and Scrum.
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: Detailed explanations of Scrum principles and practices.
Hands-On Labs: Practical exercises and simulations to apply Scrum concepts.
Case Studies: Analysis of real-world Scrum implementations and challenges.
Group Discussions: Interactive sessions to explore Scrum practices and experiences.
Quizzes and Practice Exams: Assessments to evaluate understanding and readiness for the certification exam.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: To provide a comprehensive understanding of Scrum principles, roles, and practices.
To develop skills in facilitating Scrum events and coaching Scrum teams.
To prepare participants for the Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) certification exam.
To equip participants with practical techniques for supporting and guiding Agile teams.
